correctedDefinitions.en: A complete unit or group before it is divided into parts.
correctedDefinitions.es: Una unidad o un grupo completo antes de dividirlo en partes.

rationale: Source page help text9 defines fractions as parts of a whole. Recovered Whole glossary instead describes the number of parts, conflating a unit with a denominator count.
